Built a polished dark ecommerce home page for **Nordhal**, a fictional retail brand.

**Files**: `index.html` (loads React 18 UMD), `app.js` (React component tree), `styles.css` (dark design system).

**React-style structure** (functional components with hooks):
- `App` — root with cart/wishlist state and toast
- `TopBar`, `Header` (sticky, blur), `Hero`, `Marquee`
- `Categories`, `Featured` (with tab filter via `useState`/`useMemo`)
- `ProductCard`, `Deals` (with live `Countdown` using `useEffect`)
- `Editorial`, `Newsletter` (form with validation + live region), `Footer`, `Toast`

**Dark visual style**: near-black `#0a0a0c` base, layered elevation, lime accent `#c7f23d`, glass blur cards, gradient glows in hero/newsletter, italic Playfair display accent, infinite marquee, hover lift on cards.

**Accessibility**: skip link, semantic landmarks (`header`/`main`/`footer`/`nav`), `aria-current`, `aria-pressed` for filter tabs & wishlist, `aria-live` for newsletter status & toast, labeled icon-only buttons, focus-visible ring, `prefers-reduced-motion` disables marquee, alt text strategy (decorative imagery marked `aria-hidden`).
